mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.2 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Historical unemployment spikes preceded SPX drawdowns
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates robust aggregate demand, driving corporate earnings expectations upward and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both rise in the past month
evidence_refs: doc:Consumer Spending and Housing Data Correlation
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0), supply chain disruptions reduce corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Historical supply shocks preceded SPX declines
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS > 150k in the past month) signals robust consumer spending and corporate hiring, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Strong payroll growth historically correlates with SPX gains
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 150k, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp acceleration in inflation (CPIAUCSL increasing by more than 0.3 percentage points over three months) signals the Federal Reserve may tighten policy, causing equity market sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly housing starts (HOUST) above their respective 3-month moving averages indicates robust economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both above 3-month moving averages
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST are above their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%), a further increase in inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5% and CPIAUCSL rises, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
